prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical magazine-style fashion photo of a young East Asian woman running away from the camera on an empty wide asphalt road at golden hour, captured from an extremely low rear tracking angle with a dynamic wide-angle lens. She is mid-stride and turning her head back over her shoulder toward the camera with a bright spontaneous smile, short black bob hair blowing dramatically in the wind. She wears a dusty pink sleeveless tie-back tank top, dark charcoal fitted athletic shorts, and white sneakers. Emphasize long legs in perspective, natural skin texture, cinematic sunset rim light, warm orange sunlight from the low horizon on the left, blue sky with scattered soft clouds, subtle film grain, motion blur streaking along the road surface, shallow depth of field, realistic lens distortion, lively candid energy, and an editorial summer road-trip mood. Keep the composition vertical 9:16, subject centered slightly right, no text, no watermark, no extra people, no vehicles close to the subject.

promptZh: 创作一张写实的竖版杂志风格时尚照片，画面主体为 一位年轻的东亚女性，她正在空旷宽阔的柏油路上背对着镜头奔跑，拍摄时间为黄金时刻，采用极低角度的后方跟拍视角，并使用动态广角镜头。她正处于奔跑的步伐中，转头回眸看向镜头，脸上带着灿烂自然的微笑，黑色短波波头在风中飘动。她身穿 一件灰粉色无袖系带背心、深炭灰色修身运动短裤 和白色运动鞋。画面需强调透视感下的修长双腿、自然的皮肤质感、电影级的日落轮廓光，左侧低地平线处透出温暖的橙色阳光，天空呈现蓝色并伴有稀疏的柔和云朵，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感，路面呈现动态模糊，浅景深效果，真实的镜头畸变，充满活力的抓拍感，以及夏日公路旅行的编辑风格氛围。构图保持 9:16 竖版，主体略微偏右，无文字，无水印，无多余人物，主体附近无车辆。
